attributes.action: Fund a fire plane to help fight wild fires in the UK and EU
attributes.additional_details: The UK is one of a few countries in Europe who do not have a fire plane, or simular, to fight wild fires. With climate change causing drier seasons these will become more regular. The government can also send the plane to the EU to help other countries which would then help recoup some of the cost.
attributes.background: With the recent wild fires in the UK covering large areas of the new forest, dartmoor, exmoor as well as areas close to urban areas. Will the government fund for a national fire plane to help fight fires in the UK and in the EU?

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Strengthen wildfire response - funding for dedicated firefighting aircraft" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777880
